fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Varus''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% for up to 4 seconds to increase ''Piercing Arrow's'' {{sti|range}} over the first {{fd|1.5}} seconds and its  effects over the first {{fd|1.25}} seconds of the channel.
fields.description2: ''Piercing Arrow'' can be recast within the duration. If the charge completes without reactivation, ''Piercing Arrow'' is cancelled and refunds {{sti|mana|{{as|50% of the mana cost}}}}.
fields.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Varus''' fires a piercing arrow in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. The damage of the arrow as well as any detonated ''{{ai|Blighted Quiver|Varus|Blight}}'' stacks are both increased by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0 to 50 for 6|0 to 1.25|formula=2% per 0.05 seconds. ''This is capped at 1.25 seconds.''}}, and the arrow's damage is reduced by {{pp|type=number of enemies hit|key=%|0 to 60 for 5;67|0 to 5|formula=0% + (15% per enemy hit). ''This is capped at a maximum of 67%.''}}.
